## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Combobox to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** Combobox imports 4 other components. Install them first, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Each doc lists its files; the download script below covers them too.
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
   - `popover`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/popover.md
   - `select`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/select.md
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this and the step before in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/select.css";
   @import "./components/combobox.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxCreate, ComboboxEmpty, … } from '@/ui/components/combobox';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Combobox

An input that filters a list as you type and picks one value. WAI-ARIA combobox with list autocomplete: focus stays in the input; the highlighted option is `aria-activedescendant`. Reuses the Select listbox (`components/select/listbox.tsx`).

#### Anatomy
```
<Combobox>                         context: value, inputValue, query, open, registry; hidden <input name>
  <ComboboxInput>                  <InputGroup> + <Input role="combobox"> + clear (x) + chevron buttons
  <ComboboxContent>                .ui-floating.ui-listbox anchored to the input group
    <ComboboxGroup label>          role="group"; hides itself when none of its options match
    <ComboboxItem value />         .ui-option; text children get the matching part in <mark class="ui-option-mark">
    <ComboboxCreate onCreate />    "Create “text”" row (.ui-combobox-create) when no exact match
    <ComboboxEmpty />              .ui-listbox-empty, only while no option is rendered
    <ComboboxLabel /> <ComboboxSeparator />
```

#### Props
- `Combobox`: `value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `inputValue`, `defaultInputValue`, `onInputValueChange`, `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `name`, `form`, `disabled`.
- `ComboboxInput`: `size`, `clearable`, `showTrigger` (default true), `groupClassName`, input props.
- `ComboboxItem`: `value`, `disabled`, `textValue`. `ComboboxCreate`: `onCreate(text)`, children (node or `(text) => node`).

#### Behaviour
- Typing sets `inputValue`, opens the list and filters: case and diacritic-insensitive substring on the option text. The first match is highlighted so Enter picks it.
- Filtering uses only what was typed since the list opened, so reopening a combobox that shows "Ireland" lists everything.
- Choosing sets `value`, puts the option text in the input, closes, keeps focus in the input.
- Emptying the input clears the value. Blur, outside press or Esc (open) closes and restores the selected label (or empty).
- Esc while closed clears input and value. `clearable` adds an x button.
- ArrowDown / ArrowUp open (on the selected option, else first / last) then move; PageUp / PageDown; Home / End stay caret keys. Enter chooses the highlighted option and never submits the form while open.
- `ComboboxCreate` appears when the trimmed query is non-empty and equals no option text; choosing it calls `onCreate(text)` and sets the value to the text.
- The chevron and clear buttons prevent mousedown (focus stays in the input) and are `tabindex=-1`.

#### Visual rules
- Field: `InputGroup` (see Input spec); chevron 16px, turns 180° while open (`--ui-spring-snappy`).
- List, options, groups: as Select (no check mark on the right unless selected; selected shows the check).
- Match highlight: `<mark>` with 12% foreground tint, weight 500, no padding.
- Empty text 14px muted, centred, padding 12px 8px.

#### Motion
- List: `ui-pop-in` 150ms / `ui-pop-out` 160ms. Reduced motion keeps state changes.

#### Accessibility
- Input: `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` while open, `aria-activedescendant`, named by the Field label.
- List named by the input. With no options the `listbox` role is dropped and the empty message shows.

#### Acceptance checks
- "ire" filters to Ireland with the match highlighted; "turk" finds Türkiye.
- Arrow keys move the highlight without moving focus; Enter selects; Esc restores.
- Group headings vanish when their options are filtered out.
- Create row shows only for unmatched text and adds the option.
- axe clean in light and dark.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged. Files of the components it uses are in their own docs (see Instructions).

### `ui/components/combobox/combobox.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useRef,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { Input, InputAction, InputGroup, type InputProps } from '../input';
import {
  ListboxContent,
  ListboxEmpty,
  ListboxGroup,
  ListboxLabel,
  ListboxOption,
  ListboxSeparator,
  getOptions,
  useActiveOption,
  useOptionRegistry,
  useRegisterOption,
  type ListboxContentProps,
  type ListboxOptionProps,
  type OpenIntent,
  type OptionRegistry,
} from '../select/listbox';
import { fold, highlightMatch, matchesQuery, nodeText } from '../select/listbox-utils';

interface ComboboxContextValue {
  value: string;
  inputValue: string;
  /** What the person typed since the list opened. Items filter by this, not by `inputValue`. */
  query: string;
  open: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openWith: (intent: OpenIntent) => void;
  resolveOpen: () => void;
  /** Close and put the selected label back in the input. */
  cancel: () => void;
  choose: (value: string, text: string) => void;
  clear: () => void;
  typeInto: (text: string) => void;
  anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  inputRef: RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
  listRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  listId: string;
  registry: OptionRegistry;
  activeId: string | null;
  activeRef: RefObject<string | null>;
  activate: (id: string | null, scroll?: boolean) => void;
  move: ReturnType<typeof useActiveOption>['move'];
}

const ComboboxContext = createContext<ComboboxContextValue | null>(null);

function useComboboxContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(ComboboxContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Combobox>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface ComboboxProps {
  /** Controlled selected value (`''` means nothing selected). */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Controlled text in the input. */
  inputValue?: string;
  defaultInputValue?: string;
  onInputValueChange?: (inputValue: string) => void;
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Submitted with the surrounding form under this name (via a hidden input). */
  name?: string;
  form?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Combobox — type to filter a list, pick one value. The input keeps focus and
 * highlights options with aria-activedescendant (WAI-ARIA combobox with list
 * autocomplete). Filtering ignores case and diacritics.
 */
export function Combobox({
  value: valueProp,
  defaultValue = '',
  onValueChange,
  inputValue: inputValueProp,
  defaultInputValue = '',
  onInputValueChange,
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  name,
  form,
  disabled = false,
  children,
}: ComboboxProps) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string>({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useControllableState<string>({
    value: inputValueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultInputValue,
    onChange: onInputValueChange,
  });
  const [open, setOpenState] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const [query, setQuery] = useControllableState<string>({ defaultValue: '' });
  const id = useId();
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const registry = useOptionRegistry();
  const { activeId, activeRef, activate, move, highlight } = useActiveOption(listRef);
  const intent = useRef<OpenIntent>('selected');
  const synced = useRef('');

  const selectedText = value ? (registry.get(value)?.text ?? '') : '';

  // Keep the input text in step with the selected option's label
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!value) {
      synced.current = '';
      return;
    }
    const entry = registry.get(value);
    if (!entry) return;
    const key = `${value}\u0000${entry.text}`;
    if (synced.current === key) return;
    synced.current = key;
    setInputValue(entry.text);
  }, [value, registry.version]);

  const setOpen = useCallback(
    (next: boolean) => {
      setOpenState(next);
      if (!next) activate(null);
    },
    [setOpenState, activate],
  );

  const openWith = useCallback(
    (nextIntent: OpenIntent) => {
      intent.current = nextIntent;
      // A fresh open shows every option; the query is kept while closing so the list doesn't jump
      if (nextIntent !== 'none') setQuery('');
      setOpen(true);
    },
    [setOpen, setQuery],
  );

  const resolveOpen = useCallback(() => highlight(intent.current), [highlight]);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    setInputValue(selectedText);
  }, [setOpen, setInputValue, selectedText]);

  const choose = useCallback(
    (next: string, text: string) => {
      synced.current = `${next}\u0000${text}`;
      setValue(next);
      setInputValue(text);
      setOpen(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
    [setValue, setInputValue, setOpen],
  );

  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    setValue('');
    setInputValue('');
    setOpen(false);
    inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [setValue, setInputValue, setOpen]);

  const typeInto = useCallback(
    (text: string) => {
      setInputValue(text);
      setQuery(text);
      if (!text && value) setValue('');
      if (!open) openWith('none');
    },
    [setInputValue, setQuery, setValue, value, open, openWith],
  );

  // While filtering, the first match is highlighted so Enter picks it
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !query.trim()) return;
    const first = getOptions(listRef.current)[0];
    activate(first?.id ?? null, true);
  }, [query, open]);

  return (
    <ComboboxContext.Provider
      value={{
        value,
        inputValue,
        query,
        open,
        disabled,
        setOpen,
        openWith,
        resolveOpen,
        cancel,
        choose,
        clear,
        typeInto,
        anchorRef,
        inputRef,
        listRef,
        listId: `${id}-list`,
        registry,
        activeId,
        activeRef,
        activate,
        move,
      }}
    >
      {children}
      {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} form={form} disabled={disabled} />}
    </ComboboxContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface ComboboxInputProps
  extends Omit<InputProps, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'role' | 'type' | 'name'> {
  /** Show a clear (x) button while a value is selected. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Show the chevron button that toggles the list. Default true. */
  showTrigger?: boolean;
  /** Class for the bordered group around the input. */
  groupClassName?: string;
}

const keepFocus = (e: MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault();

/** The text field. Typing filters the list; ArrowDown opens it. */
export const ComboboxInput = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, ComboboxInputProps>(function ComboboxInput(
  {
    size = 'md',
    clearable = false,
    showTrigger = true,
    groupClassName,
    className,
    onChange,
    onKeyDown,
    onClick,
    onBlur,
    disabled,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useComboboxContext('ComboboxInput');
  const field = useFieldControl({ disabled });
  const isDisabled = Boolean(field.disabled || ctx.disabled);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, ctx.inputRef);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || isDisabled || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ctx.open) ctx.move('next');
        else ctx.openWith('selected-first');
        return;
      case 'ArrowUp':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ctx.open) ctx.move('prev');
        else ctx.openWith('selected-last');
        return;
      case 'PageDown':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.move('pageDown');
        }
        return;
      case 'PageUp':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.move('pageUp');
        }
        return;
      case 'Enter':
        if (ctx.open) {
          // Never submit the form while the list is open
          e.preventDefault();
          if (ctx.activeRef.current) document.getElementById(ctx.activeRef.current)?.click();
        }
        return;
      case 'Escape':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.cancel();
        } else if (ctx.inputValue || ctx.value) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.clear();
        }
        return;
    }
  };

  return (
    <InputGroup ref={ctx.anchorRef} size={size} className={groupClassName}>
      <Input
        {...props}
        ref={ref}
        size={size}
        role="combobox"
        autoComplete="off"
        autoCapitalize="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        aria-autocomplete="list"
        aria-expanded={ctx.open}
        aria-controls={ctx.open ? ctx.listId : undefined}
        aria-activedescendant={ctx.open && ctx.activeId ? ctx.activeId : undefined}
        disabled={isDisabled}
        value={ctx.inputValue}
        className={className}
        onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
          onChange?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.typeInto(e.target.value);
        }}
        onClick={(e) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented && !ctx.open && !isDisabled) ctx.openWith('selected');
        }}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          onBlur?.(e);
          if (ctx.open) ctx.cancel();
        }}
      />
      {clearable && ctx.value && !isDisabled && (
        <InputAction aria-label="Clear" tabIndex={-1} onMouseDown={keepFocus} onClick={ctx.clear}>
          <Icon name="x" />
        </InputAction>
      )}
      {showTrigger && (
        <InputAction
          aria-label="Show options"
          aria-expanded={ctx.open}
          tabIndex={-1}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          onMouseDown={keepFocus}
          onClick={() => {
            ctx.inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            if (ctx.open) ctx.cancel();
            else ctx.openWith('selected');
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="chevron-down" className="ui-combobox-chevron" />
        </InputAction>
      )}
    </InputGroup>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface ComboboxContentProps
  extends Omit<ListboxContentProps, 'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'listId' | 'listRef' | 'onOpened' | 'multiselectable' | 'header'> {}

/** The floating list. Put items, groups and `ComboboxEmpty` inside. */
export const ComboboxContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ComboboxContentProps>(function ComboboxContent(
  { 'aria-labelledby': labelledBy, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useComboboxContext('ComboboxContent');
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);

  useDismiss(ctx.open, [panelRef, ctx.anchorRef], () => ctx.cancel(), { escape: false });

  return (
    <ListboxContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.anchorRef}
      listId={ctx.listId}
      listRef={ctx.listRef}
      onOpened={ctx.resolveOpen}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy ?? (ctx.inputRef.current?.id || undefined)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface ComboboxItemProps
  extends Omit<ListboxOptionProps, 'optionId' | 'selected' | 'highlighted' | 'onChoose' | 'onActivate' | 'value' | 'indicator'> {
  /** The value this option stands for. Must be unique and non-empty. */
  value: string;
  /** Plain text to filter and show in the input when `children` isn't text. */
  textValue?: string;
}

/** One option. Hidden while it doesn't match what was typed; text children get the match highlighted. */
export const ComboboxItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ComboboxItemProps>(function ComboboxItem(
  { value, disabled, textValue, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useComboboxContext('ComboboxItem');
  const id = useId();
  const text = textValue ?? nodeText(children);
  useRegisterOption(ctx.registry, value, text, children, disabled);
  if (!matchesQuery(text, ctx.query)) return null;
  return (
    <ListboxOption
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      optionId={id}
      value={value}
      selected={ctx.value === value}
      highlighted={ctx.activeId === id}
      disabled={disabled}
      onChoose={() => ctx.choose(value, text)}
      onActivate={() => ctx.activate(id)}
    >
      {typeof children === 'string' ? highlightMatch(children, ctx.query) : children}
    </ListboxOption>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface ComboboxCreateProps
  extends Omit<ListboxOptionProps, 'optionId' | 'selected' | 'highlighted' | 'onChoose' | 'onActivate' | 'value' | 'indicator' | 'children'> {
  /** Called with the typed text when it is chosen. Add the option in your state; the value becomes the text. */
  onCreate: (text: string) => void;
  /** Label for the row. Default: Create “text”. */
  children?: ReactNode | ((text: string) => ReactNode);
}

/** A “Create …” row. It appears only when the typed text doesn't exactly match an existing option. */
export const ComboboxCreate = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ComboboxCreateProps>(function ComboboxCreate(
  { onCreate, children, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useComboboxContext('ComboboxCreate');
  const id = useId();
  const text = ctx.query.trim();
  if (!text) return null;
  const folded = fold(text).out;
  if (ctx.registry.entries().some((entry) => fold(entry.text).out === folded)) return null;
  return (
    <ListboxOption
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      optionId={id}
      value={`__create__:${text}`}
      selected={false}
      highlighted={ctx.activeId === id}
      indicator="none"
      className={cn('ui-combobox-create', className)}
      onChoose={() => {
        onCreate(text);
        ctx.choose(text, text);
      }}
      onActivate={() => ctx.activate(id)}
    >
      <Icon name="plus" className="ui-combobox-create-icon" />
      {typeof children === 'function' ? children(text) : (children ?? <>Create “{text}”</>)}
    </ListboxOption>
  );
});

/** “No results” text; shows only while nothing matches. */
export const ComboboxEmpty = ListboxEmpty;
/** A labelled set of options: `<ComboboxGroup label="Europe">…</ComboboxGroup>`. Hides when none of its options match. */
export const ComboboxGroup = ListboxGroup;
/** A group heading, as a child of <ComboboxGroup>. */
export const ComboboxLabel = ListboxLabel;
/** A divider between groups. */
export const ComboboxSeparator = ListboxSeparator;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/combobox.css`

```css
/* Combobox ------------------------------------------------------------------
   The field is an <InputGroup>: <div class="ui-input-group"><input class="ui-input" role="combobox">
   <button class="ui-input-action">chevron</button></div>. The floating list is the shared
   .ui-listbox from select.css. This file only adds what is specific to the combobox.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-combobox-chevron {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-input-action[aria-expanded="true"] > .ui-combobox-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

  /* "Create …" row */
  .ui-combobox-create .ui-option-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-combobox-create-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-combobox-create[data-highlighted] .ui-combobox-create-icon { color: inherit; }
}
```

## Usage

**Country** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/combobox/country.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxGroup, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem } from '@/ui/components/combobox';
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';

const countries = [
  ['AT', 'Austria', 'Europe'],
  ['BE', 'Belgium', 'Europe'],
  ['CA', 'Canada', 'Americas'],
  ['CH', 'Switzerland', 'Europe'],
  ['CO', 'Colombia', 'Americas'],
  ['CZ', 'Czechia', 'Europe'],
  ['DE', 'Germany', 'Europe'],
  ['ES', 'Spain', 'Europe'],
  ['FR', 'France', 'Europe'],
  ['IE', 'Ireland', 'Europe'],
  ['IN', 'India', 'Asia and Pacific'],
  ['JP', 'Japan', 'Asia and Pacific'],
  ['MX', 'Mexico', 'Americas'],
  ['NZ', 'New Zealand', 'Asia and Pacific'],
  ['PL', 'Poland', 'Europe'],
  ['SE', 'Sweden', 'Europe'],
  ['TR', 'Türkiye', 'Europe'],
  ['US', 'United States', 'Americas'],
] as const;

const regions = ['Europe', 'Americas', 'Asia and Pacific'];

export default function ComboboxCountry() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <Label>Billing country</Label>
      <Combobox name="country" defaultValue="IE">
        <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search countries" clearable />
        <ComboboxContent>
          {regions.map((region) => (
            <ComboboxGroup key={region} label={region}>
              {countries
                .filter(([, , r]) => r === region)
                .map(([code, name]) => (
                  <ComboboxItem key={code} value={code}>
                    {name}
                  </ComboboxItem>
                ))}
            </ComboboxGroup>
          ))}
          <ComboboxEmpty>No country matches your search.</ComboboxEmpty>
        </ComboboxContent>
      </Combobox>
      <FieldHint>Used for tax and invoice formatting. Try typing “turk” or “ire”.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
  );
}
```
